title: AggregationMethod
description: Aggregation-methodology taxonomy for cross-risk-type economic capital (AGG-1). The chosen method {summation, constant_diversification, variance_covariance, copula, full_simulation} is an EXPLICIT receipted governed choice carrying its stated trade-off and limitation. Summation is the conservative super-additive upper bound: a method returning MORE than summation is REJECTED. A variance_covariance aggregate claiming more diversification than a tail-dependent copula/simulation is FLAGGED (diversification vanishes in the tail).

risk_inputs.description: Per-risk-type standalone economic capital (the marginal quantile at `confidence`).

assumption.description: The declared correlation/copula/diversification assumption. A diversifying method with none is REJECTED (no silent diversification).

limitation.description: The stated limitation of the chosen method (recorded on the receipt).
